channel.title: Carbone Notes
channel.description: Notes, analysis and guides on technology, security, science and digital culture.

item.title: Freezers Tampered, Food Destroyed: Cyberattacks Reach the Supermarket Cold Chain
item.description: The losses in this story are measured in spoiled food, not encrypted files.

item.title: Ericsson's CTO Predicts India Will Lead on Agentic AI — the Supply Chain Is the Hard Part
item.description: Ericsson's technology chief expects India to lead the world in adopting agentic AI, but says the real test lies in building the supply chain behind it.

item.title: Nine Women in London and the Blind Spot in Digital Health
item.description: A dead phone battery is a minor annoyance for most people; in a digital-first health system, it can be the exact point where access quietly ends.

item.title: Fusion Power: Ignition Hurdles and the Road to Grid Power
item.description: A grounded look at the gap between a fusion milestone in a laboratory and the engineering required for reliable grid electricity.

item.title: The Science of Rest: Rethinking Digital Fatigue
item.description: We are living through a massive, unmonitored human trial. Every waking hour, we feed our brains continuous streams of high-intensity digital stimulation. We wake up to notifications, eat lunch scrolling through feeds, and go to bed with bright screens inches from our eyes.

item.title: The Cloud Repatriation Movement is Gaining Steam
item.description: For the past decade, the tech mantra was simple: migrate everything to the cloud. AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud became the default destinations for startups and enterprises alike. But in 2026, a growing counter-cultural movement is gaining ground: cloud repatriation.

item.title: Prompt Injection: The Silent Ghost in the LLM Shell
item.description: The developer community has been racing to hook up Large Language Models (LLMs) to tools. We give them internet browsing access, email-reading abilities, and shell access. But in doing so, we've created a massive new attack surface: indirect prompt injection.

item.title: Vaping: What Nobody Tells You Before You Start
item.description: I started vaping a month ago. I'm quitting while writing this.
